in_sanskrit.name: Golla
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Cowherd
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Golla एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Go-Lah' which means 'Cowherd'. In Hindu mythology, Golla is a title given to various gods and characters who are associated with cattle or agriculture.
